topics.title: Why 0.1 + 0.2 is not 0.3
topics.catch: Binary floats can't store 0.1 exactly, so tiny errors appear
topics.verdict: Never compare floats with ==; use integers (cents) or a decimal type for money
topics.demand_evidence: own judgment: classic question, no demand data behind it

topics.title: Cache stampede: when one expired key kills your database
topics.hook: One hot key expires and a thousand requests hit the DB at once
topics.catch: Every request misses together and the DB falls over
topics.verdict: Lock so one request rebuilds, or refresh early before expiry (TTL jitter dropped: Wikipedia does not cover it)
topics.demand_evidence: Nucamp 'Top 25 Backend Interview Questions 2026' #18 (caching)

topics.title: Idempotency keys: how a retry doesn't charge you twice
topics.hook: Network times out, client retries, customer charged twice
topics.catch: Retries are unsafe for non-idempotent writes
topics.verdict: Client sends a unique key; server stores the first result and replays it
topics.demand_evidence: Nucamp 'Top 25 Backend Interview Questions 2026' #1 and #4 (idempotency)

topics.title: Why is my SQL query slow? (indexes)
topics.hook: Same query: scans a million rows vs jumps straight to one
topics.catch: An index speeds reads but slows writes and takes space
topics.verdict: Index columns you filter and join on; check with EXPLAIN
topics.demand_evidence: Nucamp 'Top 25 Backend Interview Questions 2026' #5 (slow SQL)

topics.title: JWT vs session cookie: where does login state live?
topics.hook: Server remembers you vs you carry a signed token
topics.catch: A JWT can't be easily revoked before it expires
topics.verdict: Short expiry plus refresh, or server sessions when you need instant logout
topics.demand_evidence: Nucamp 'Top 25 Backend Interview Questions 2026' #12 (auth/JWT)
topics.source_to_verify: https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc7519 ; OWASP Session Management Cheat Sheet

topics.title: CAP theorem in plain English
topics.hook: Network splits: do you answer possibly stale, or refuse?
topics.catch: During a partition you must pick consistency or availability
topics.verdict: Choose per feature (payments vs likes), not per company
topics.demand_evidence: Nucamp 'Top 25 Backend Interview Questions 2026' #6 and #24; DesignGurus 'most frequently asked system design questions' (consistency)

topics.title: Sync API vs message queue: when to wait and when not to
topics.hook: User waits 30 s for an email vs gets instant OK and email arrives later
topics.catch: Queues add delay, ordering and duplicate-delivery issues
topics.verdict: Queue slow, non-urgent work; keep the answer-now path synchronous
topics.demand_evidence: Nucamp 'Top 25 Backend Interview Questions 2026' #19

topics.title: The N+1 query problem
topics.hook: One page load fires 101 queries instead of 2
topics.catch: Lazy loading hides a query per row in a loop
topics.verdict: Join or prefetch (eager load) and watch query counts
topics.demand_evidence: Nucamp 'Top 25 Backend Interview Questions 2026' #5 (adjacent: slow queries)

topics.title: CORS: why your browser blocks your own API
topics.hook: Request works in Postman, fails in the browser
topics.catch: CORS is browser-enforced, not a server security feature
topics.verdict: Server sends the right Access-Control headers; never use * with credentials
topics.demand_evidence: own judgment: classic question, no demand data behind it

topics.title: Rate limiting with a token bucket
topics.hook: One client sends a flood and everyone slows down
topics.catch: Bursts and per-instance counters make limits uneven
topics.verdict: Refill tokens at a steady rate; share state across servers
topics.demand_evidence: DesignGurus 'most frequently asked system design questions' (tips: rate limiting)

topics.title: Docker vs VM: what a container really is
topics.hook: VM boots a whole OS vs container starts in moments
topics.catch: Containers share the host kernel, so isolation is weaker
topics.verdict: Containers for packaging and speed; VMs when you need hard isolation
topics.demand_evidence: Nucamp 'Top 25 Backend Interview Questions 2026' #14

topics.title: Exponential backoff with jitter
topics.hook: 1,000 clients retry together every second and re-crash the server
topics.catch: Plain retries synchronize into a thundering herd
topics.verdict: Double the wait each time and add randomness
topics.demand_evidence: Nucamp 'Top 25 Backend Interview Questions 2026' #4 (idempotent retries) adjacent

topics.title: OAuth 2.0: how 'Login with Google' works
topics.hook: You log in without giving the app your Google password
topics.catch: Redirect URIs and codes can be stolen if not validated
topics.verdict: Authorization code flow with PKCE; exact redirect URI match
topics.demand_evidence: Nucamp 'Top 25 Backend Interview Questions 2026' #12 (OAuth2)

topics.title: Consistent hashing: add a server without reshuffling everything
topics.hook: mod N remaps almost every key when N changes vs ring moves a few
topics.catch: Uneven load unless you add virtual nodes
topics.verdict: Hash ring plus virtual nodes
topics.demand_evidence: DesignGurus 'most frequently asked system design questions' (sharding, scaling)

topics.title: What happens when you type a URL and press Enter
topics.hook: One keystroke triggers DNS, TCP, TLS, HTTP
topics.catch: Each hop adds latency, any can fail
topics.verdict: Cache DNS, reuse connections, use a CDN
topics.demand_evidence: own judgment: classic question, no demand data behind it

topics.title: Load balancing: round robin vs least connections
topics.hook: Same servers, one overloaded, one idle
topics.catch: Round robin ignores uneven request cost; sticky sessions hurt balance
topics.verdict: Least connections plus health checks
topics.demand_evidence: DesignGurus 'most frequently asked system design questions' (load balancing)

topics.title: SQL injection in 30 seconds
topics.hook: A login box with ' OR 1=1 gets in
topics.catch: String-built queries let input become code
topics.verdict: Parameterized queries; ORM alone is not a guarantee
topics.demand_evidence: Nucamp 'Top 25 Backend Interview Questions 2026' #12 (security: SQL injection)

topics.title: Logs vs metrics vs traces
topics.hook: Site is slow: which tool tells you why?
topics.catch: More telemetry costs money and noise
topics.verdict: Metrics to detect, traces to locate, logs to explain
topics.demand_evidence: Nucamp 'Top 25 Backend Interview Questions 2026' #15

topics.title: API versioning without breaking clients
topics.hook: Rename one field and every mobile app breaks
topics.catch: Many versions mean many things to maintain
topics.verdict: Version explicitly, deprecate with a date, never remove silently
topics.demand_evidence: Nucamp 'Top 25 Backend Interview Questions 2026' #10

topics.title: ACID with a bank transfer
topics.hook: Debit succeeds, credit fails: money vanishes
topics.catch: Stronger isolation costs throughput
topics.verdict: Wrap both steps in one transaction
topics.demand_evidence: Nucamp 'Top 25 Backend Interview Questions 2026' #4

topics.title: How a HashMap really works
topics.hook: Lookup in a million items takes one step
topics.catch: Collisions and resizing cost time
topics.verdict: Good hash plus load factor; Java converts long buckets to trees
topics.demand_evidence: own judgment: classic question, no demand data behind it
